title: access@1
description: The access words a manifest grants, from a closed list (technical-design.md, Access): files, programs, hosts, run-as-you, the screen, sound, the microphone, the camera, a device class as device:<class>, the clipboard, a window, the agent, edit_as_you and the record. A device class is name@major, or a plug-in's own ext.<plug-in>.<name>@major. Any other word fails, naming it.
